creator: nocturne
statement: Maestro is locked behind a hidden quest chain with multiple requirements

creator: nocturne
statement: Quest can only be done by a beginner class character and progress is not shared between characters

creator: nocturne
statement: Do not pick any class at the level 10 class selection quest on the character meant for Maestro

creator: nocturne
statement: You must obtain the Peanut Recipe from the Picnic Stowaway by completing his first daily quest

creator: nocturne
statement: Three Picnic Stowaway quests must be done before the daily quest is accessible

creator: nocturne
statement: First daily quest requires 200 Frog Legs and 100 Bean Slices

creator: nocturne
statement: Peanut Recipe drops on the ground when you pick up the second quest for the first time

creator: nocturne
statement: First step to Maestro is becoming a Journeyman which is the basic class for Maestro

creator: nocturne
statement: Once Journeyman the character is locked out of becoming Warrior or Archer or Mage

creator: nocturne
statement: Journeyman quest chain needs 1651 Peanuts and 250 Gold Bars

creator: nocturne
statement: Journeyman quest chain needs 1651 Peanuts and 250 Gold Bars

creator: nocturne
statement: Each Peanut is crafted in Anvil tab 1 from 2 Hot Dogs and 1 Copper Ore and 1 Bleach Log

creator: nocturne
statement: Total materials for all peanuts: 3302 Hot Dogs and 1651 Copper Ore and 1651 Bleach Logs

creator: nocturne
statement: Recommends having all materials ready before beginning the quest chain

creator: nocturne
statement: Start the chain at the bush next to the Jungle Tree in the Vegetable Patch World 1 by dropping 1 Peanut near it

creator: nocturne
statement: Bush has 3 more quests needing 50 then 200 then 400 peanuts dropped; completion gives a Stone Peanut

creator: nocturne
statement: Take the Stone Peanut to the suspicious rock in the bottom right of Froggy Fields and drop it to get the fifth quest

creator: nocturne
statement: Fifth quest requires dropping 500 more Peanuts on the ground at the rock

creator: nocturne
statement: After the rock quest you get a Golden Peanut recipe then craft Golden Peanuts at the town Anvil

creator: nocturne
statement: After the rock quest you get a Golden Peanut recipe then craft Golden Peanuts at the town Anvil

creator: nocturne
statement: Each Golden Peanut needs 100 Peanuts and 50 Gold Bars and quest needs 5

creator: nocturne
statement: Drop the 5 Golden Peanuts at the rock to become Journeyman and get a trophy

creator: nocturne
statement: Next chain requires a Bag o Nuts and Googly Eyes for a boss summon and several skill levels

creator: nocturne
statement: Required skill levels: Mining 32 and Smithing 35 and Chopping 33

creator: nocturne
statement: Required skill levels: Fishing 23 and Alchemy 25 and Catching 25

creator: nocturne
statement: Bag o Nuts needs 5 quests from Goldric in the Shifty Sandbox in World 2

creator: nocturne
statement: Goldric quest one: collect 15 coins from the ground after quest starts by killing Sand Castles

creator: nocturne
statement: Goldric quest two: Catching minigame 15 hoops in a row or 90 hoops total

creator: nocturne
statement: Third quest: 200 cards each from Mimics and Mafiosos and Sand Castles

creator: nocturne
statement: Mimics are in Mimic Hole; Mafiosos in Grandioso Canyon; Sand Castles in Shifty Sandbox

creator: nocturne
statement: Fourth quest wants a Golden Plop dropped by Poops in the World 1 Sewers

creator: nocturne
statement: Fifth quest requires wearing Golden Helmet and Golden Plate Body and Golden Plate Legs plus any Golden Tool

creator: nocturne
statement: Take the Bag o Nuts to Snelbies area second to last map in Yum Desert and drop it at the Cactus

creator: nocturne
statement: Cactus has 3 quests: mining/smithing/chopping levels then fishing/alchemy/catching levels then defeat the boss

creator: nocturne
statement: Third quest: defeat Biggie Hours World 2 mini boss while holding Pete the Peanut given at quest start

creator: nocturne
statement: While Pete is in inventory HP drops to 1 and damage is halved

creator: nocturne
statement: After killing Biggie Hours return to the cactus to turn in and become Maestro

creator: nocturne
statement: Maestro needs level 70 to equip the trophy which gives large Skill EXP and Defense bonus

creator: nocturne
statement: No rush to complete the questline since trophy is only usable at level 70

creator: nocturne
statement: Method one: use a Wooden Bow to fight at range and dodge by going down the rope ladder as he approaches

creator: nocturne
statement: Go back up only when he is far from the bridge and descend as soon as he turns back; wait enough time

creator: nocturne
statement: Method two: above 594 Defense he cannot damage you so you can punch him to auto attack

creator: nocturne
statement: Use best armor such as Dementia Gear or Efaunt Gear from the World 2 boss for Defense

creator: nocturne
statement: Dementia or Efaunt gear gives bonuses such as 7% Defense just for the boots equipped

creator: nocturne
statement: Keychains from Dungeons can have up to 10 Defense

creator: nocturne
statement: Use the highest Upgrade Stones; World 4 stones give 4 Defense each

creator: nocturne
statement: Spend Flurbos in the Dungeon Flurbo Shop for percent Defense but it is costly to upgrade enough

creator: nocturne
statement: Golden Meat Pie gives a percent boost to total Defense

creator: nocturne
statement: Orange alchemy bubble FMJ gives percent Defense from equipment and 1 base Defense per class level

creator: nocturne
statement: Amarok's Obol gives percent Defense and 5 base Defense

creator: nocturne
statement: Circular Obols can also give more Defense

creator: nocturne
statement: Oak Tree card gives base Defense; Forest Soul card gives percent Defense; Sheepie card gives Defense

creator: nocturne
statement: Golden Giftmas Box card gives percent Defense

creator: nocturne
statement: Frostbite Tundra card set gives Defense and Accuracy

creator: nocturne
statement: In World 3 the Isaccian Shrine gives more HP and Defense; slow to level but percentage based

creator: nocturne
statement: Box of Unwanted Stats second stat increases Base Defense

creator: nocturne
statement: Ned Kelly star sign gives +6% Defense and Weapon Power

creator: nocturne
statement: Murmollio star sign gives 10% more Defense
